shots.name: The challenge
shots.narration: A film can look right, and still be wrong.
shots.action: The complete frame-zero challenge is interrupted by a scan at 0.65s. By 1.45s a magnified actual controlled-draft candidate covers the beautiful ring, with readable controlled-test and frame labels.
shots.goal: Make the sceptic recognise the gap between a convincing still and a reliable film.
shots.focalPoint: The giant word proof and the luminous folded object.
shots.transition: The ribbon flattens into the waveform axis while the headline compresses upward.
shots.sound: A low opening pulse and glass harmonic; first phrase has room to breathe.

shots.name: Measured sound
shots.narration: So this film checks its own sound, and masters the result.
shots.action: The production waveform grows out of the ribbon; measured before and after loudness values lock onto its edge.
shots.goal: Give mastered audio a visible, inspectable result.
shots.focalPoint: The waveform and its sourced loudness measurement.
shots.transition: The waveform collapses into a beat rail and the inspection light becomes the cut marker.
shots.sound: Bass and dry percussion enter. Voice band carve preserves the low pulse.

shots.name: The pulse
shots.narration: Its cuts sit on the score’s beat grid.
shots.action: One recognisable blue ribbon folds at the beat-rail gate, then opens into a rectangular aperture at the next gate. The aperture grows into the candidate boundary during 14.8–16s; the actual six-cut grid result is large enough to read.
shots.goal: Let the audience feel a beat-aligned edit before reading its check.
shots.focalPoint: One optical object at a time, then the beat rail.
shots.transition: The aperture expands and clears into the central draft inspection window.
shots.sound: Full syncopated groove; a clean kit tick marks each plate.

shots.name: The missing frame
shots.narration: A planted one frame glitch is caught in the draft, then removed.
shots.action: Actual cropped before, candidate and after captures isolate the ring without nested titles or captions. An opaque repaired capture appears beneath the candidate; fading only the top capture removes the rose patch without dimming unchanged pixels.
shots.goal: Show that a tiny defect produces concrete evidence before a human review.
shots.focalPoint: The isolated candidate and the corrected frame.
shots.transition: The candidate pointer draws into a source connection.
shots.sound: The groove thins to a heartbeat; a dry tick on detection and a soft landing on repair.
shots.hold: Reading time for the real controlled-test frames.

shots.name: Trace the claim
shots.narration: Every number you see leads back to this film’s evidence.
shots.action: The candidate boundary grows into the report receipt. Its literal mastering / after / integrated nesting reveals the measured value in stages; a drawn connection terminates beside that value and the large on-screen figure. Portrait uses a tall side connection.
shots.goal: Make numerical honesty part of the film’s visible structure.
shots.transition: The source line opens into two rectangular apertures.
shots.sound: Arpeggio returns in a higher register with one bright source-lock accent.

shots.name: Both layouts
shots.narration: The motion is checked forwards and backwards, in both layouts.
shots.action: The receipt edge opens into the landscape preview alongside a portrait preview. Real rendered frames of this film from 11.0–15.5s scrub forward and reverse together, with a shared readable exact source timestamp. The portrait composition gives its tall preview the dominant area.
shots.goal: Show the separate compositions and the fact that rendered motion is checked.
shots.transition: The two captures contract while the original ribbon resolves above the product lockup.
shots.sound: The largest harmonic lift; rhythmic elements peel away into the resolution.

shots.name: The invitation
shots.action: The original ribbon resolves into the emblem, giant product name and one executable next step.
shots.goal: Leave developers with the product name and how to begin.
shots.focalPoint: Motion Mania, then the init command.
shots.transition: Resolve and hold the wordmark through the end.
shots.sound: Suspended harmony resolves to major; no narration; a long clean decay.
